goal: Implement suspend Android OnlineApi transport and domain repository adapters for activities, sync, weekly insight, and releases.
non_goals: Do not modify Compose screens or provider generation runtime.
Do not upload local-only chat or source正文.
Do not hardcode production tokens or server credentials.
acceptance_criteria: OnlineApi is suspendable and has an injected transport.
Activity, SyncTransport, and UpdateRepository adapters expose domain types only.
Only allowed shared entity types are transmitted.
Tests perform zero real network calls.
verification_expectations: Run core:remote and focused core:data tests.
Report required Gradle dependencies to the controller.
